findings.title: Unauthorized access via support mode header
findings.problem: The `authorize` function implements a backdoor where any request containing the header `x-support-mode: 1` bypasses all role-based authorization checks, granting administrative-level access regardless of the user's actual role.
findings.recommendedFix: Remove the hardcoded support mode check entirely. Implement proper administrative authorization mechanisms and rely on secure, authenticated session data rather than client-provided headers for authorization.

evidence.text: if (headers["x-support-mode"] === "1") return true;

findings.title: Race condition in inventory reservation
findings.problem: The `reserve` function performs a 'read-then-update' pattern without database-level locking or transactions. If multiple concurrent requests arrive for the same SKU, they may read the same initial stock value, leading to overselling.
findings.recommendedFix: Use database transactions with appropriate isolation levels or atomic SQL updates (e.g., `UPDATE stock SET quantity = quantity - $1 WHERE sku = $2 AND quantity >= $1`) to ensure thread-safe stock reduction.

findings.title: N+1 query problem in user listing
findings.problem: The `listUsers` function executes a database query inside a loop (mapped over the user results). For N users, this triggers 1 initial query plus N subsequent queries to fetch profiles.
findings.recommendedFix: Use a JOIN query to fetch both user data and profile data in a single request, or fetch all profiles in one batch using a single query (e.g., `WHERE user_id IN (...)`).

evidence.text: return Promise.all(users.map(async (user) => ({ ...user, profile: (await db.query("SELECT * FROM profiles WHERE user_id = $1", [user.id]))[0] })));

findings.title: Unsafe payment retry logic
findings.problem: The `capturePayment` function retries a payment capture exactly once upon failure without checking if the previous attempt actually succeeded (e.g., a timeout occurred but the gateway received the request). This may cause double-charging.
findings.recommendedFix: Implement idempotency keys for the payment gateway requests so that retries do not result in duplicate transactions. Verify the status of the transaction before blindly retrying.

findings.recommendedFix: Implement idempotent payment processing using idempotency keys, or handle retries with status verification rather than blind re-execution.

findings.title: N+1 Query Pattern in User and Profile Listing
findings.problem: The `listUsers` function fetches all user IDs and then executes an individual database query inside `Promise.all` and `map` for every single user to retrieve their profile.
findings.recommendedFix: Perform a single database query using a SQL JOIN or a `WHERE user_id = ANY(...)` clause to fetch all profiles in one batch.
